interpretation_rules: Preserve the raw bytes exactly before decoding.
Treat multi-byte NoConversion values as unsigned little-endian only after the local raw response is checked against the existing splitter/Vitosoft integer convention.
Do not expose any reset or write path for maintenance values during this validation.
Do not add productive polling until local reads are successful and values are plausible for this exact appliance.
Keep these service values separate from burner fault unlock/reset semantics.
